text:
sarah: Heads up — customer COBALT reporting tool-calling failures right after v3.1 canary (15%). They see schema validation errors and wrong tool args. Attaching initial error + repro.

omar: Customer acct: acct_94b2, req_id r_20260315_44. Symptoms: tool_call returns malformed params or string instead of object, causing downstream tool to error. Example error:
```
{ "error": "tool_call_schema_validation_failed", "details": "expected params object for tool 'web_search', got string 'latest revenue'" }
```

lucy: Repro'd locally hitting hosted v3.1 canary — model emits `tool_call.name = web_search` but `tool_call.params = \"latest revenue\"` (a string) or occasionally `null`. Pinning model=v3.0 returns correct `{ "query": "latest revenue" }`. Looks model-version-specific.

kevin: pinging @eng-runtime @eng-ml. Did router or runtime change function-calling wiring recently? Could be prompt change or model artifact.

eng-runtime-bot: Note from deploys: v3.1 rolled 2026-03-10 03:12 UTC, canary 15% us-west. No router code changes since then. Runtime v2.4.1. Function-calling validation in runtime is currently warn-only (does not reject responses).

sarah: Customer repro steps they used:
1) POST /v1/generate with ``model=v3.1``
2) body: ```json
{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that uses tools."},{"role":"user","content":"Search latest revenue"}], "functions":[{"name":"web_search","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}}, "required":["query"]}}]}
```
3) response contains `tool_call` with `params` as a raw string.

omar: Proxy logs:
[2026-03-15T08:22:11Z] req=r_20260315_44 route=canary model=v3.1 tool_call={"name":"web_search","params":"latest revenue"} status=200

lucy: Quick experiment: send same prompt with `model=v3.0` -> tool_call params are correct object. So regression confined to v3.1.

kevin: Options:
1) pause/rollback v3.1 canary immediately (low lift, immediate mitigation)
2) patch runtime to enforce strict schema validation (reject or transform bad tool_call responses)
3) ask eng-ml to revert/fix prompt variant that changed serialization behavior
If this is customer-facing, my vote is rollback + root cause fix.

eng-ml: Investigating. We changed a system prompt variant in the v3.1 family that inadvertently serializes single-field params as raw strings in certain completions. Not expected. Preparing a prompt fix and new candidate. ETA ~30m to push candidate to staging.

sarah: Customer impact: search queries returning 0 results because tool receives a string instead of `{query: ...}`. They want ETA.

kevin: Recommend immediate canary pause and rollback to v3.0 for canary cohort. Plan: schedule rollback in 10m, notify affected customers, follow with postmortem and fix plan. Any objections?

lucy: +1 rollback. Also strongly recommend runtime quick fix to reject non-object params (fail fast) so we don't silently return bad tool outputs.

eng-runtime-bot: Rollback initiated by kevin. Canary paused. Traffic for canary cohort routed back to v3.0. Rollback id rb_20260315_1. Monitoring.

support-bot: Notifying customer: "We observed an unexpected regression in v3.1 tool-calling causing malformed tool args. We have paused the v3.1 canary and routed your traffic back to v3.0. ETA for fix ~30-45m; we'll follow up." :white_check_mark:

omar: Logging follow-up: creating INC-321 and attaching proxy + model logs and repro. Will collect more telemetry on how often `params` is string vs null.

kevin: Post-rollback actions: 1) eng-ml to fix prompt and produce new candidate; 2) eng-runtime to add schema-enforcement option (reject non-object params) and enable it for next canary; 3) add an eval asserting function params are JSON objects across prompts; 4) re-run canary at 5% with strict validation.

lucy: I'll add the eval (test) to the function-calling suite and a quick integration check in the CI gate for canaries.

eng-ml: Confirmed fixed prompt candidate deployed to staging. Will request canary retry once runtime validation is in place. Will also add a regression test in our model onboarding to catch serialization changes.

sarah: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer thread with rollback and ETA. Keep this thread updated with monitoring / re-canary schedule. :thumbsup:

kevin: Monitoring shows errors dropping after rollback. Closing urgent alert but keeping ticket open until fix + guarded canary are done.

omar: Filing postmortem and copying this thread into INC-321. Will include repro steps and sample logs.

sarah: Closing loop for now. We'll reopen if anything changes.
